answer: One nullifier-bound credential per human. Each key spends a nullifier from a $1 video-verified issuance secret; two keys reusing a secret emit one nullifier, so clones unmask and their bonds burn. Rain on karst: each reused secret drains into a crack the ledger mapped. The registry is a beacon: one duplicate flash freezes the clone and pays the reporter. Cost: an honest identity = $1 fee + 3 min human time = $1.05; 100 clones need 100 fresh verifications ($105), any reuse torches a $50 bond per collision. Nectar is priced per bee, not per hive - forged wings never sweeten one flower.
